recommendation_note: Coding uses one independent benchmark cohort. Value is a transparent same-subscription performance-capacity proxy, not predicted successful tasks. Existing Go recommendations remain conditional and unchanged.

coding.harness: mini-swe-agent; max 500 steps; full transcript, no compaction
coding.endpoint_scope: native model; OpenCode Go endpoint untested
coding.effort_policy: record evaluated effort per row; unknown stays null; not equal token budgets
coding.unknown_policy: exclude missing / ambiguous checkpoints / Contributor mappings from numeric sorting; zero is a valid measured score

value.metric: Go subscription performance-capacity value index; comparable cohort maximum=100
value.price_assumption: base short-context tier; DeepSeek off-peak; active promotions included
value.limits: shared Go quota; 5h and weekly windows still apply; capacities cannot be summed across models
value.exclusions: free/unlimited and missing data are not ranked
value.not_equivalent_to: official request estimates, successful tasks, success probabilities, measured cost per solved task, or universal recommendations
value.normalization: all eligible Go rows, independent of UI filters; active promotions; re-evaluated at render time
value.limitations: linear performance-capacity proxy at equal subscription fee; effort varies; low-capability inexpensive models may score high
